target.title: feat(dashboard): redesign live and triage pages with a minimal lobster theme
target.body:
Complete visual redesign of the ClawSweeper status dashboard and both triage pages: minimal, modern, and a tad lobstery. No behavioral changes — same data, same routes, same client logic; this is presentation only (plus the tiny label-pill markup it needed).

## Before / after

![Dashboard before and after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/03a47a516a8cb87253d60c921d044056cb18c207/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-before-after.jpg)

![Triage before and after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/03a47a516a8cb87253d60c921d044056cb18c207/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/triage-before-after.jpg)

<details>
<summary>More captures: dark variant, worker drill-down dialog</summary>

![Dashboard after, dark variant](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/03a47a516a8cb87253d60c921d044056cb18c207/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-after-dark.png)

![Worker dialog after](https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/raw/03a47a516a8cb87253d60c921d044056cb18c207/docs/assets/dashboard-redesign/dashboard-after-worker-dialog.png)

</details>

All "after" captures were rendered against a saved production `/api/status` / `/api/triage` snapshot served locally, so before and after show identical live data.

## What changed

- Warm minimal theme that follows the system color scheme via CSS `light-dark()`: shell-white light mode, warm charcoal dark mode, replacing the fixed navy theme.
- One accent color: lobster coral. It marks everything alive — links, running capacity slots, in-progress steps, worker progress, section-heading ticks, the pulsing LIVE tag, and a 2px top stripe. Status colors (green/amber/red/violet) stay semantic.
- Removed all decoration: radial background gradients, card gradients, shimmer and wave animations, glow shadows, hover translates. The LIVE dot pulse is the only remaining animation.
- Metrics became a single hairline-divided stat strip; flow map dropped its arrow chrome; pills went from filled chips to quiet outlines; tables/cards flattened to hairline borders with 10-12px radii; tabular numerals throughout.
- Emoji removed from metric labels and section headings; the lobster stays in the page title, header, and empty states.
- Triage tables: GitHub label colors now render as neutral dot-pills (small color dot + hairline pill) instead of dark filled chips, and issue titles are text-colored with coral on hover.
- Updated the UTF-8 emoji regression test to assert the new labels while keeping the mojibake guard and the title lobster check.

## Verification

- `pnpm run build:dashboard` (tsgo), `pnpm run lint:dashboard` (oxlint), `pnpm run format:check` all clean.
- `node --test test/dashboard-worker.test.ts`: 53/53 pass.
- Rendered and visually verified every surface against the production data snapshot: metric strip, system overview, capacity rail, automatic builds, worker cards and filters, worker/automatic dialogs, active pipeline, cluster intake, automerge, closed stats, worker health, operations, recent activity, both triage pages, and the light and dark variants.

Note: the stylesheet uses `light-dark()` and `color-mix()`, which need 2024+ evergreen browsers — fine for this maintainer-facing dashboard.
